subject: Mutual plan onboarding: Veridian evaluation timeline & stakeholder roles
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan onboarding: Veridian evaluation timeline & stakeholder roles

Hi Sofia —

Great speaking with you earlier. Following up with an initial mutual plan (high-level) to align on goals, timeline, and who will own which pieces from both sides. I attached a draft for reference (Veridian_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) and a short evaluation checklist.

Goals we heard:
- Validate inference latency/throughput on our target workloads (summaries + chat)
- Confirm cost envelope for expected qps and 95th latency SLOs
- Verify security controls (SOC 2 scope, VPC options) and integration path for embeddings store

Suggested timeline (flexible):
1) Week 0 (Jun 21–25): kickoff with engineering + security; share dataset/access details
2) Week 1–2: infra-onramp, SRE runbook, smoke tests
3) Week 3–4: evaluation runs, metrics collection, quality check against prompt set
4) Week 5: procurement + legal review; SOW draft review
5) Week 6: exec review & decision

Asks from your side to finalize the MAP:
- Confirm champion: who will drive internal coordination (we heard Sofia maybe?)
- Confirm technical leads and procurement contact (name & email)
- Any hard dates/blocks we should avoid in June–July

If this looks good we can book a 30–45m MAP kickoff next week. Proposed time: Thu Jun 24 10:00–10:45 PT. I’ll invite Marissa (solutions engineer) for the technical segment and Priyom to cover rollout/contracting items.

Attachments: Veridian_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, eval-checklist.xlsx

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0114

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ella Rodriguez <ella.rodriguez@veridianhealth.com>, James O'Neill <james.oneill@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan onboarding: Veridian evaluation timeline & stakeholder roles

Thanks Karthik — this is very clear and helpful. I can be the champion and will run internal coordination. Quick notes from our side: 

- Confirming attendees for the kickoff: me (Sofia, Product), Ella Rodriguez (ML Engineering lead), and James O'Neill (procurement, cc'd).
- Suggested tweak to timing: our ML team is heads-down the week of Jun 28 for a release; if possible, can we shift evaluation runs to start Jul 5 instead of Jun 28? That would put decision week at mid-July, which is fine.
- For the dataset access, we'll provide a masked sample (S3 link) and a short rubric for quality checks.

I’m available Thu Jun 24 at 10am PT — please go ahead and send the invite. Also can you add a short procurement checklist for James so he has visibility before kickoff?

Appreciate the outline — quick procurement/legal notes from my side before kickoff: 

- Please include a short security packet with SOC 2 type II scope and our standard data handling questionnaire answers (PII handling, retention, deletion flow). If you have an attestation or SOC report stub, that helps speed procurement.
- For contracting, we operate with a standard PO + SOW cadence. Can you attach a proposed SOW (even draft) we can circulate to legal?
- Pricing: we'll need a ballpark cost line for expected usage during evaluation so finance can provision a temporary budget code.

Cc'ing Priyom so he can help put the draft SOW on your side and confirm timing.

Great — thanks everyone for the quick replies and for confirming roles. Action items and next steps below: 

1) Kickoff: Thu Jun 24, 10:00–10:45 PT — calendar invite sent (Zoom). Agenda: 5m intros, 15m technical & dataset, 15m evaluation metrics & run plan, 10m procurement/next-steps.
2) Timeline tweak: moving evaluation runs to start Jul 5 as Sofia suggested — updated MAP attached (Veridian_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf -> now reflects Jul 5 start).
3) Security packet & SOW: Priyom will share a short procurement checklist and a draft SOW (SOW-proposal.pdf) by Mon Jun 21. James — we will include SOC 2 scope and a brief answers doc; Marissa will share the security/infra notes in that packet.
4) Dataset: Sofia to share masked S3 sample + rubric ahead of kickoff (please upload link to the invite or drop to this thread).

Owners: 
- Champion/Coordination: Sofia Martinez (Veridian)
- ML Eng lead / dataset: Ella Rodriguez (Veridian)
- Procurement/Contracts: James O'Neill (Veridian)
- AE / commercial: Karthik Iyer (Redwood)
- Solutions / security: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Procurement liaison / SOW: Priyom Das (Redwood)

Attachments included: Veridian_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (updated), eval-checklist.xlsx, SOW-proposal.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VER-2027-0421

If anything above needs to change before Monday, flag it here — otherwise we’ll proceed with the updated schedule and get the kickoff on the calendar. Looking forward to it.

Thanks —
Karthik
